_about: Founding and constitutional charts of nations (and the EU and UN, kept for comparison). One primary chart per country (primary: true) with alternates. time is local civil time at place; tz_east is that moment's zone from the tz database (local mean time before standard zones). time_confidence: exact = legally fixed moment (usually midnight transfers of power); reported = a contemporary account of the minute; approx = the part of the day is known; date = day only, cast at local noon. Every non-midnight time was checked against the cited source; where sources disagree the notes say so.
